task.description:
Write test specifications and test code for EE-12 (Concurrent instance safety) per the design in src/design/engine.md section EE-12.

Required test artefacts:

1. Test spec file: tests/specs/EE-12.md covering:
   - Test case TC-EE-12-01: 100 concurrent task completions across 100 DISTINCT instances all succeed
   - Test case TC-EE-12-02: Two concurrent task completions on the SAME instance - one HTTP 200, one HTTP 409
   - Test case TC-EE-12-03: Verify no deadlock occurs with multiple concurrent instances
   - Test case TC-EE-12-04: Verify HTTP 409 with code CONCURRENT_MODIFICATION is returned on contention
   Format: follow the style of tests/specs/EE-11.md or similar existing specs.

2. Integration test file: tests/integration/test_ee12_concurrent.zig (or equivalent Zig test file) implementing the above test cases. The tests should:
   - TC-EE-12-01: Create 100 process instances, advance each to USER_TASK, then complete all 100 tasks concurrently (using threads or async). Assert all 100 succeed and final instance state is correct.
   - TC-EE-12-02: Create 1 instance, advance to USER_TASK, then fire two concurrent completeTask calls on the same instance. Assert exactly one succeeds (HTTP 200) and one fails (HTTP 409 CONCURRENT_MODIFICATION).
   - TC-EE-12-03: Run TC-EE-12-01 scenario and assert no deadlock (all goroutines/threads complete within timeout).
   - TC-EE-12-04: Trigger the NOWAIT path and verify the JSON response contains the field code with value CONCURRENT_MODIFICATION.

The ConcurrentModification error and HTTP 409 translation are already implemented in src/engine/instance.zig and src/api/routes/tasks.zig.

After writing tests, run zig build test to verify all tests compile and pass.
Run zig build to confirm no build regressions.
acceptance_criteria: tests/specs/EE-12.md exists with test cases TC-EE-12-01 through TC-EE-12-04
Integration test file exists implementing concurrent test scenarios
TC-EE-12-01 verifies 100 distinct-instance concurrent completions all succeed
TC-EE-12-02 verifies same-instance contention: one HTTP 200, one HTTP 409 CONCURRENT_MODIFICATION

result.summary: Test spec and integration tests for EE-12 (Concurrent Instance Safety). Fixed critical bug in completeTask() (SELECT id → SELECT instance_id). Added bpm.transition export. Tests skip gracefully without BPM_TEST_DB_URL.

issues.description: Fixed pre-existing bug in completeTask() step-f: SELECT id was changed to SELECT instance_id — the id column does not exist on instance_projections. This bug caused completeTask to always return ConcurrentModification against a real DB.
